author: Glenn Kinley
title: Stojakovic explodes in first half, Illinois basketball improves to 2-0 - NewsBreak
text:
By Glenn Kinley ,
1 hours ago
CHAMPAIGN, Ill. (WCIA) - Illinois men's basketball led Penn by just one point after nine and a half minutes of play.
The Illini, who were heavy favorites entering the game, quickly put a sizeable gap between themselves and the Quakers.
Illinois went on a 18-1 run in the first half to lead by 23 at halftime, 53-30. Senior guard Andrej Stojakovic scored 21 points in the first half.
Illinois didn't slow up in the second half, surpassing 100 points with 5:37 left in the game.
Illinois went on to win the 2026 NCAA Tournament rematch, 112-70.
Stojakovic finished with 25 points to lead all scorers.
The win came despite Illinois being without preseason All-American David Mirkovic, who continues to work back to full health after foot surgery and emergency appendectomy. Jake Davis also did not play, he had shoulder surgery on Wednesday after getting hurt in Illinois' season-opening win against Fairleigh Dickinson.
Illinois freshman Quentin Coleman scored 19 points, and Zavier Zens added 18.
The No. 3 ranked Illini improve to 2-0 with the win but now turn their sights to a much tougher challenge. Illinois visits No. 19 Texas Tech on Tuesday, Nov. 10.
